headline: Kai, stocks carried records into Friday — at 8:30 the American consumer gets the last word.
subline: July retail sales land this morning with September hike odds faded to about 35%, Hormuz stays shut with WTI near $82, and the S&P starts from Thursday's record 7,798.99.
asof: Pre-market · as of 6:45 AM ET · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Futures steady near records ahead of retail sales
items.sentence: Yahoo Finance's premarket board shows S&P 500 futures at 7,829.00, up 0.08%, with WTI near $82 and bitcoin easing about 1.3% to $62,784 ahead of the 8:30 data.

items.title: S&P 500 closes at a record 7,798.99
items.sentence: The index rose 0.65% Thursday — Nasdaq up 0.81%, Dow up 0.13% — and Workday jumped 18% on reported Silver Lake buyout talks, per The Motley Fool.

items.title: Retail sales seen up 0.1% this morning
items.sentence: Investing.com's calendar pegs July retail sales at +0.1% with core at +0.2%, and has Michigan consumer sentiment expected at 54.4 later in the morning.

items.title: Soft PPI pushes September hike odds toward 35%
items.sentence: Markets now price roughly a 35% chance of a September rate increase, down from 55% a week earlier, after Thursday's softer-than-expected producer-price data, per Trading Economics.

items.title: Ten-year yield edges back up to 4.67%
items.sentence: Trading Economics marks the 10-year at 4.67% this morning — up 0.02 points on the session, 0.11 over the past month, and 0.35 in a year.

items.title: Hormuz stays shut as Iran sets reopening terms
items.sentence: Tehran says the strait stays closed until Washington pays war reparations and lifts sanctions, with daily crossings near 10 vessels versus 130 pre-war, per Al Jazeera.

items.title: Second carrier heads toward the Middle East
items.sentence: The USS George Washington is steaming toward the region after reports of strain and supply problems aboard the long-deployed USS Abraham Lincoln, per NPR.

items.title: Magnitude-7.4 earthquake shakes western Colombia
items.sentence: NPR examines the quake that struck western Colombia and the potential for additional seismic events along the fault.

items.title: Judge tosses Trump antisemitism case against Harvard
items.sentence: A federal judge dismissed the administration's civil-rights case against the university, per NPR.

items.title: Nevada fake-electors case dismissed
items.sentence: A judge dropped the prosecution of Nevadans accused of forging electoral certificates in the 2020 election, per NPR.

items.title: Z.ai aims at Anthropic and OpenAI in coding
items.sentence: Bloomberg reports Z.ai's new AI model is built to catch Anthropic and OpenAI in the coding market.

items.title: Nvidia opens Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
items.sentence: The open 30B mixture-of-experts model claims up to 4x higher output speed and ships alongside a new routing library, per AI Weekly.

items.title: SpaceX holds above its $135 IPO price
items.sentence: Shares traded at $146.59 after a Starlink satellite launch, comfortably above the $135 IPO price, per TheStreet.

items.title: UK courts ban Meta smart glasses
items.sentence: Courtrooms in England and Wales barred the glasses over covert-recording concerns, per AI Weekly.

items.title: Anthropic signs 191 MW compute deal with Riot
items.sentence: AI Weekly reports a 20-year contract with Riot Platforms worth about $9.1 billion through 2048 — one more bitcoin miner routing its power toward AI.
